args.body: The nightly build fails because `round_money` uses `ROUND_HALF_UP` while `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212. This change switches the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
